capabilities: Generate text in place from @[prompt] syntax in notes
Replace the prompt with Markdown output such as tables or summaries
Configure the OpenAI model, API key, and 32k variants
Point to a custom URL for local OpenAI-compatible servers
Adjust the window size of surrounding context sent to the model
extras: Warns that the number of tokens sent to the API affects cost; features beyond current ones may be added on request, but the author intends to keep functionality simple.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate text in place from a prompt written inside a note.

relations.evidence: a local LLM setup with an OpenAI-compatible API (examples include LocalAI, Ollama, LM Studio)
